name: @silakagent/mcp

tools.name: silak_bootstrap_test
tools.description: Initialise a Silak QA suite for the active browser tab (or a URL), or for a connected Android device screen. Idempotent per target — safe to call once per target.

url.description: Target URL. Defaults to the active tab (web only).

platform.description: 'web' (default) or 'android' to target a device via android-runner.

serial.description: Android device serial (platform=android). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_generate_page_summary
tools.description: Analyse the live UI of the target (web DOM, or Android UI hierarchy of a connected device) and return a structural summary (pages/screens, forms, interactive elements).

url.description: Optional URL to open before analysing (web only).

platform.description: 'web' (default) or 'android' to summarise a device screen.

serial.description: Android device serial (platform=android). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_generate_standardized_prd
tools.description: Reverse-engineer a standardized PRD (overview, user stories, functional requirements) from the current page/screen summary.

serial.description: Android device serial (platform=android). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_generate_test_plan
tools.description: Generate a test plan (TC001, TC002...) with Given/When/Then steps and categories from the PRD and page/screen summary. Set platform=android for native Android steps.

description.description: Optional focus for the test plan.

platform.description: 'web' (default) or 'android' — generated cases carry this platform.

serial.description: Android device serial (platform=android). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_explore_features
tools.description: Feature Exploration (TestSprite-style): discovers the app's main use cases and returns the 'use cases walked' (name + steps + succeeded/partial/failed + success signal) plus pages visited, grounding later PRD/test-plan/flow generation in real observation. For web (platform 'web' or omitted) an agent walks the live web app from the current tab and auto-loads the stored test setup (silak_set_test_setup) for the current origin. For platform 'android' it reads the active device screen (UI hierarchy) via the connected android-runner (pass serial to target a device). Requires the Silak AI endpoint.

url.description: Optional URL to open before exploring (web only).

platform.description: 'web' (default) or 'android' (read active device screen via android-runner).

serial.description: Android device serial to target (platform "android"); defaults to the selected device.

instruction.description: Optional focus for the exploration (e.g. "checkout and account flows").

scope.description: Optional strict scope (web): the agent explores ONLY these items and will not wander outside them (include stop conditions, e.g. "stop after successful login; do not visit other pages"). Mirrors the in-panel scope checklist.

username.description: Optional login username to explore behind auth (web only).

password.description: Optional login password (used with username, web only).

tools.name: silak_generate_maestro_flow
tools.description: Author a declarative Android UI flow (Maestro-style .yaml) for the active app on the connected android-runner device: reads the current UI hierarchy and generates a deterministic flow (tapOn/inputText/assertVisible/... resolved by text or id), stores it as an Android test case, and returns { suiteId, testCaseId, appId, yaml }. Silak executes the flow itself via the runner (adb/Appium) — NO Maestro CLI install required. Run it deterministically (native, 0-token) with silak_rerun_tests (pass the testCaseId + serial). Requires the Silak AI endpoint.

instruction.description: What the flow should do (e.g. "add a task 'go to the gym' due today").

serial.description: Android device serial to target; defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_set_test_setup
tools.description: Save the per-origin test setup used by silak_explore_features and the in-panel wizard: website URL, extra instructions, and a login test account (username/password). Stored locally (IndexedDB) on the user's machine — never sent to a server. Origin is taken from url (or the active tab).

url.description: Website URL (its origin keys the setup). Defaults to the active tab.

username.description: Login username/email for the test account.

tools.name: silak_get_test_setup
tools.description: Read the stored test setup for a url origin (or list all). Passwords are never returned — only whether credentials exist and the username.

url.description: Return the setup for this url origin. Omit to list all.

tools.name: silak_delete_test_setup
tools.description: Delete an entire test app (project) for a url origin: its setup, test cases, runs, explorations, and test files. Destructive.

url.description: Url whose origin identifies the test app to delete.

tools.name: silak_get_exploration
tools.description: Fetch a stored Feature Exploration result: by explorationId, or all explorations for a suiteId, or the most recent explorations when no argument is given.

suiteId.description: List explorations for this suite (newest first).

tools.name: silak_generate_and_execute
tools.description: Generate the test plan if needed and execute every test case live — in the browser (web) or on a connected Android device (platform=android) — returning pass/fail results.

description.description: Optional focus for the test plan.

platform.description: 'web' (default) or 'android' to run against a connected device.

serial.description: Android device serial (platform=android). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_generate_test_plan_from_document
tools.description: Generate a test plan (test cases) from a pasted document/PRD text (no live page needed). Creates a new suite and stores the cases. Requires a configured AI endpoint.

text.description: Document / PRD text to generate cases from.

tools.name: silak_rerun_tests
tools.description: Rerun a previously generated test case (or the whole latest plan) live. Web cases run in the browser; Android cases run on a connected device (platform is taken from the stored test case).

testCaseId.description: Optional test case id. Defaults to the latest plan.

serial.description: Android device serial (for android test cases). Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_export_report
tools.description: Generate a test report for a run. Returns markdown, json, html, csv or junit text.

format.description: markdown | json | html | csv | junit (default markdown).

tools.name: silak_open_test_result_dashboard
tools.description: Open the Silak result dashboard (review, edit and rerun test cases).

runId.description: Optional run id to focus its report.

section.description: QA section to open: 'web' (default, web tests) or 'mobile' (Android/mobile tests).

tools.name: silak_list_suites
tools.description: List all test suites (flows): id, name, description, timestamps. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_suite
tools.description: Get a suite by id together with its test cases. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_rename_suite
tools.description: Rename a suite (flow).

tools.name: silak_delete_suite
tools.description: Delete a suite and ALL its test cases. Destructive.

tools.name: silak_list_test_cases
tools.description: List test cases, optionally filtered by suiteId. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_test_case
tools.description: Get a single test case by id (title, platform, content/steps). Read-only.

tools.name: silak_create_test_case
tools.description: Create a new freeform test case in a suite. The text is a natural-language instruction the agent will execute when run. Returns the new test case id.

suiteId.description: Suite id to add the case to.

tools.name: silak_update_test_case
tools.description: Update a freeform test case title, text, and/or priority.

tools.name: silak_delete_test_case
tools.description: Delete a test case by id. Destructive.

tools.name: silak_list_runs
tools.description: List test runs, optionally filtered by testCaseId. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_run
tools.description: Get a test run by id together with its step results (instruction, success, output, assertions). Read-only.

tools.name: silak_delete_run
tools.description: Delete a test run by id and cascade (its step results, screenshots, reports). Destructive.

tools.name: silak_list_page_summaries
tools.description: List stored page summaries (structural analyses). Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_page_summary
tools.description: Get a stored page summary by id. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_list_prds
tools.description: List stored standardized PRDs. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_prd
tools.description: Get a stored standardized PRD by id. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_get_page_state
tools.description: Read the current active tab's indexed interactive elements + page content (the agent's 'eyes'). Optionally navigate to url first. Use the element indexes with silak_click_element / silak_input_text / silak_select_option. Does NOT use the extension AI endpoint — the MCP client is the brain. Re-call after the page changes to refresh indexes. Read-only.

url.description: Optional URL to open before reading.

tools.name: silak_click_element
tools.description: Click the interactive element at the given index (from silak_get_page_state) on the active tab. Shows the element highlight. Part of the client-as-brain primitive set (no extension AI used). Response includes { selector } — the element's stable xpath; record it to replay this action later with silak_click_by_selector (no re-reading the page, no LLM).

tools.name: silak_input_text
tools.description: Type text into the element at the given index on the active tab. Response includes { selector } (stable xpath) — record it to replay later with silak_input_by_selector.

tools.name: silak_select_option
tools.description: Select a dropdown option by visible text on the element at the given index. Response includes { selector } (stable xpath) — record it to replay later with silak_select_by_selector.

tools.name: silak_click_by_selector
tools.description: Deterministic replay: click the element matching a stable xpath selector (obtained from an earlier silak_click_element response). Re-finds the element by selector even after the page re-rendered — no silak_get_page_state needed first, no LLM. Use to replay a previously-recorded flow fast. Returns { success: false } if the selector no longer matches (then fall back to reading the page + index-based tools).

selector.description: Stable xpath selector from a prior action response.

tools.name: silak_input_by_selector
tools.description: Deterministic replay: type text into the element matching a stable xpath selector (from an earlier silak_input_text response). No page read, no LLM. Returns { success: false } if the selector no longer matches.

selector.description: Stable xpath selector from a prior action response.

tools.name: silak_select_by_selector
tools.description: Deterministic replay: select a dropdown option by visible text on the element matching a stable xpath selector. No page read, no LLM. Returns { success: false } if the selector no longer matches.

selector.description: Stable xpath selector from a prior action response.

tools.name: silak_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the active page. direction: 'up'|'down'|'left'|'right' (default 'down').

tools.name: silak_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the active tab (or a new tab) to a URL, then refresh the element tree.

newTab.description: Open in a new tab instead of the active tab.

tools.name: silak_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the active browser tab. Returns a PNG data URL. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_android_list_devices
tools.description: List Android devices currently visible to the connected android-runner (serial + model), and which one is selected. Requires a runner paired in the Silak Android Runners panel.

tools.name: silak_android_select_device
tools.description: Set the active/selected Android device serial for subsequent tools.

tools.name: silak_android_set_engine
tools.description: Set the execution engine for an Android device: 'appium' (element-based taps with a coordinate fallback, installs a helper APK) or 'adbShell' (coordinate-based taps, no APK install — use when the device blocks APK installs). Persists per device in the runner.

serial.description: Android device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: silak_android_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the connected Android device. Returns a PNG data URL.

tools.name: silak_android_ui_hierarchy
tools.description: Return the current Android UI hierarchy (nodes with ref/text/resourceId/bounds). Use the node refs with silak_android_tap / silak_android_input_text. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_android_tap
tools.description: Tap an Android element by its ref (obtained from silak_android_ui_hierarchy).

ref.description: Element ref from the UI hierarchy.

tools.name: silak_android_input_text
tools.description: Type text into an Android element by its ref.

ref.description: Element ref from the UI hierarchy.

tools.name: silak_android_swipe
tools.description: Swipe on the Android screen in a direction (up|down|left|right).

ref.description: Optional element ref to swipe on.

tools.name: silak_android_press_key
tools.description: Press an Android hardware/nav key (back|home|enter|appSwitch).

tools.name: silak_android_open_mirror
tools.description: Open the live screen-mirror page for a device in a browser tab.

tools.name: silak_run_task
tools.description: Run a free-form natural-language task in the browser using Silak's built-in agent (the extension is the 'brain', using the user's configured AI endpoint). One-shot: e.g. "open a new tab, go to youtube.com, play the first video". Requires a configured AI endpoint — if none, returns an error suggesting the primitive tools (silak_get_page_state + silak_click_element) so the MCP client acts as the brain instead. Returns { runId, status, output }.

task.description: Natural-language task to perform in the browser.

model.description: Optional model override for this task.

tools.name: silak_list_shortcuts
tools.description: List saved Teach shortcuts (recorded manual workflows) available for replay.

tools.name: silak_run_shortcut
tools.description: Replay a saved Teach shortcut live in the browser, by id or name.

name.description: Shortcut name (used if id is omitted).

tools.name: silak_create_shortcut
tools.description: Create a saved Teach shortcut (a reusable named prompt/workflow).

startUrl.description: Optional URL to open before running.

tools.name: silak_update_shortcut
tools.description: Update a saved shortcut by id (name, prompt, and/or startUrl).

tools.name: silak_delete_shortcut
tools.description: Delete a saved shortcut by id. Destructive.

tools.name: silak_record_start
tools.description: Start recording manual browser interactions (clicks/inputs/selects) on the active tab. Each interaction is captured with a multi-attribute element fingerprint for accurate deterministic replay. No AI runs during recording. Stop with silak_record_stop.

tools.name: silak_record_stop
tools.description: Stop recording, let AI structure the captured steps into ONE bounded test case (no invented clicks) with a deterministic replay bundle, and store it. Returns { testCaseId, suiteId, stepCount }.

suiteId.description: Optional suite id to add the case to.

tools.name: silak_create_session
tools.description: Create a new Silak chat session (a fresh "New chat"). Optionally bind it to a tab group (groupId) and window (windowId) for per-group isolation. Returns the session id and title.

groupId.description: Chrome tab group id to bind this session to (per-group isolation).

windowId.description: Chrome window id that owns the group.

tools.name: silak_list_sessions
tools.description: List saved Silak chat sessions (most recent first), with title, message count, updatedAt, and bound groupId/groupTitle. Optionally filter by groupId.

groupId.description: Only return sessions bound to this Chrome tab group id.

tools.name: silak_get_session
tools.description: Get a chat session by id, including its full message list. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_rename_session
tools.description: Rename a chat session (set its title).

tools.name: silak_delete_session
tools.description: Delete a chat session by id. Destructive.

tools.name: silak_list_tab_groups
tools.description: List Silak tab groups in the current window (id, title, color, windowId) together with the bound chat session (if any). Read-only.

windowId.description: Window to list groups for. Defaults to the current window.

tools.name: silak_current_group
tools.description: Report the tab group of the currently active tab (id, title, windowId) and whether a Silak session is bound to it. Returns { grouped:false } when the active tab is not in a group. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_list_window_tabs
tools.description: List all tabs in the current browser window (id, title, url, active, groupId, pinned). Mirrors the "include all tabs" scope of the chat agent — use to understand every open tab in this window, not just the Silak group. Read-only. Scope is the current window only, never other windows.

windowId.description: Window to list tabs for. Defaults to the current window.

tools.name: silak_resolve_element_source
tools.description: Resolve the source-code location of the interactive element at the given index (from silak_get_page_state) — returns { file, line?, column?, componentName? } or null. Reads the element's data-silak-source attribute (injected by the dev build). Use to jump from a runtime element to its source in the editor. Read-only, no LLM.

tools.name: silak_flow_impact
tools.description: Given a source file path, list the stored web flows whose recorded actions touch that file — returns { flows: [{ testCaseId, title, suiteId, files }] }. Used for editor watch-mode (replay only impacted flows on save). Suffix-matches the path against each flow action target sourceRef. Read-only, no LLM.

path.description: Source file path (relative to the workspace).

tools.name: silak_list_page_errors
tools.description: List recent captured page errors (JS onerror/unhandledrejection + failed network requests) from the in-memory ring buffer — returns { errors: [{ url, message, stack?, sourceRef?, at }] }, newest first. Requires errorForwarding enabled (silak_set_settings). Read-only.

limit.description: Max number of recent errors to return.

tools.name: silak_get_settings
tools.description: Get the extension's non-secret settings: AI endpointUrl, modelName, maxSteps, stepDelaySeconds, contextWindow, temperature, verifyRetries, language, executionMode, includeAllTabs, watchMode, devServerOrigin, errorForwarding, theme ('light'|'dark'|'system'), and hasApiKey (boolean). The apiKey itself is NEVER returned. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_set_settings
tools.description: Update settings. Any provided field is merged. apiKey is write-only (can be set, never read back). Fields: endpointUrl, apiKey, modelName, maxSteps, stepDelaySeconds, contextWindow (model token budget), temperature (0-2), verifyRetries (how many times the agent must re-verify a failing test case or unfinished command before it is allowed to report failure), language ('id'|'en'), executionMode ('ask'|'auto'), includeAllTabs (bool), watchMode (bool — editor watch-mode replay on file save), devServerOrigin (string — origin whose flows watch-mode may replay), errorForwarding (bool), theme ('light'|'dark'|'system' — UI appearance of sidepanel + dashboard).

contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens; page content and prompts are trimmed to fit.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature 0-2. Omit to never send the parameter.

verifyRetries.description: Re-verification budget (0-10). On a failing test case or an unfinished command, only that failing unit is retried; the agent stops as soon as it passes.

includeAllTabs.description: Include all window tabs in agent context.

watchMode.description: Replay impacted flows when the editor reports a file save.

devServerOrigin.description: Only flows on this origin are replayed by watch-mode.

errorForwarding.description: Capture page JS/network errors into the ring buffer (silak_list_page_errors).

tools.name: silak_list_models
tools.description: List model ids available from the configured AI endpoint. Requires endpointUrl set.

tools.name: silak_test_connection
tools.description: Verify the user's configured AI endpoint by sending one short chat completion to the saved endpoint/model (not just listing models). Returns { ok, model, reply } on success or { ok:false, model, error } on failure. Read-only diagnostic.

tools.name: silak_open_settings
tools.description: Open the Silak settings dashboard on a specific section (AI endpoint, MCP Bridge, Editor Bridge, Data & Storage).

tools.name: silak_storage_usage
tools.description: Report the estimated size of Silak's local data in this browser (IndexedDB), as bytes and a human-readable string, plus `qaFolder` — the filesystem folder Silak writes run videos/screenshots/reports to: `{ supported, name, permission: 'granted'|'prompt'|'none', bytes?, humanReadable? }`. Picking or changing that folder requires a user gesture in the extension UI (Settings → Data & Storage), so it cannot be done over MCP. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_export_backup
tools.description: Export ALL suites (with test cases, runs, step results, screenshots, reports) as a JSON backup object. Read-only.

tools.name: silak_import_backup
tools.description: Import a backup object previously produced by silak_export_backup. Writes data.

tools.name: silak_reset_data
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: wipe ALL Silak local data (IndexedDB) — chat history, test cases, runs, screenshots. AI endpoint config is preserved. Requires confirm:true or it is refused.

tools.name: silak_system_metrics
tools.description: Report live CPU and memory usage of this machine (via chrome.system). Read-only.

tools.name: silak_list_browsers
tools.description: List the Silak Agent browsers currently connected to this bridge (id, label, whether it is the active target). Use when more than one browser is connected to know which browserId to target. Read-only, handled by the bridge itself.

tools.name: silak_use_browser
tools.description: Select which connected browser subsequent tool calls target (when more than one is connected). Persists for this session until changed. Every relayed tool also accepts an optional "browserId" argument to override the target for a single call.
